## Hypothesis

We aim to validate the BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (call) setup's edge across VIX regimes (low <15, medium 15-22, high >22) using walk-forward OOS over the last 3 years. The hypothesis is that the setup exhibits regime-dependent performance, with stronger edge in moderate VIX (15-22) due to sufficient premium and trend persistence, while low VIX (<15) may lack momentum and high VIX (>22) may induce premature exits via volatility crush.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger requires ≥2 of: (1) level reclaim (close above support after test), (2) EMA ribbon flip to bullish-stack (Fast > Pivot > Slow), (3) confluence with multi-day/premarket structure. Entry at next bar open after trigger bar closes.  
**Exit:** Primary management via ribbon ride: TP1 at +100% premium (sell ⅔), runner stop trails at chandelier 0.15 off HWM after TP1. Catastrophe stops: chart-stop (close below reclaimed level +$0.50 buffer) and premium stop (−50% Safe/−5% Bold). Time stop 15:50 ET.
